title: US Nuclear Regulatory Commission opens its draft AI Strategic Plan for 2023-2027 for public comment
summary: Comments were accepted until 19 August, with a public webinar on 3 August.

title: Bloomberg reports US officials asked the Dutch government to stop ASML selling a key chipmaking tool to China
summary: The report, dated 5 July, concerns restricting China's access to an ASML chipmaking tool.

title: BigScience releases BLOOM, a 176-billion-parameter open-access multilingual language model
summary: The model was trained on the Jean Zay public supercomputer in France, and CNRS published a press release on 12 July.

title: Midjourney opens its text-to-image platform in open beta
summary: Midjourney announced the open beta on 12 July.

title: DeepMind researchers say an AI system learned to design a redistribution policy that players voted for in an online economic game
summary: Alphabet's DeepMind reported that an AI-designed mechanism for sharing funds in an investment game won majority support from human participants over baseline policies.

title: Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems researchers report a dog-sized four-legged robot that learned to walk in about one hour
summary: Researchers in Germany described a quadruped robot that taught itself to walk within roughly an hour using a learning-based control approach.

title: OpenAI begins admitting about one million waitlisted users to DALL-E 2 and grants commercial rights to images, Habr reports
summary: Habr reports access widens over the following weeks with partly paid credits, reversing the earlier ban on commercial use.

title: Baidu unveils Apollo RT6 driverless vehicle planned to join its fleet in 2023, BBC reports
summary: The BBC article dated 21 July describes the vehicle unveiled at Baidu's event.

title: Bloomberg reports China's SMIC has shipped chips made with a 7-nanometre process
summary: The 21 July report describes a significant advance over the chipmaker's earlier chips.

title: Google fires engineer Blake Lemoine, citing data-security policy breaches and calling his LaMDA claims 'wholly unfounded'
summary: The Verge reports the dismissal on 22 July after his claim that LaMDA was sentient.

title: Chess-playing robot grabs and breaks the finger of a seven-year-old opponent in Moscow, Guardian reports
summary: The Guardian article dated 24 July reports the incident at a chess event.

title: Japan's Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications publishes the 2022 report of its AI Network Society Promotion Conference
summary: The MIC conference, chaired by Chuo University professor Osamu Sudoh, released its 2022 report on social, economic, ethical and legal issues of AI networks.
srcName: Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications (Japan), Arabic press release

title: US road-safety regulator NHTSA writes to Tesla about a hidden FSD Beta mode that disabled driver monitoring
summary: NHTSA sent the letter under investigation EA 22-002 with a Special Order requesting information.

title: DeepMind says AlphaFold predictions for more than 200 million protein structures are now in a free public database
summary: DeepMind reports the structures cover virtually all known proteins.
